ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity region extending from the baseline to the median notch. Lateral high-intensity fields on both lobes exhibit dense dark mottling. Right lobe contains discrete dark linear features and a central dark V-shaped focal point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate calculated interior angle of 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge. Notable jagged irregularities and protrusions are concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature from the median notch toward the distal tips, with the lower edge exhibiting a broad convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-intensity circular pixel clusters (barnacles) concentrated on the outer distal tips. Approximately 6-8 discrete white circular spots are visible within the central low-intensity region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detections of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally and vertically across the light-pigmented fields of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips causing irregular geometric deformations of the perimeter. Significant dark linear scarring on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark 'V' shaped mark located in the central-right high-intensity field.
